name: compassion
quote: I'll call a vet who can help your dog!
description: Recognizing the suffering of a person or animal with an active desire to alleviate that suffering.

commentaries.quote: With pity, there's a sense that the person sorta deserves the suffering. With sympathy, they're innocent victims but you can only help with moral support. With compassion, you're offering more tangible help.

Compassion is seen by some as a virtue and by others as a bad practice. If you believe everyone should help each other, then you'll see it as a virtue and likely hope it will be reciprocated should you ever need help. But if you believe people should be responsible for their own situation, you may see 'bleeding heart' compassion as creating weakness in others.

conditions: You recognize undeserved suffering in another want to help them.
